settings.label: Server
settings.help: The ntfy server to listen to — ntfy.sh, or your own (http:// works too). Just the address: no username or password in it

settings.label: Topic
settings.help: Which topic to listen to. Letters, numbers, - and _ only, like ntfy itself. On a public server anyone who knows the name can post to it, so pick one nobody would guess

settings.label: Catch up on
settings.help: How far back to fill the tile when connecting, e.g. 12h, 7d, or all. These never raise notifications

settings.label: Show notifications
settings.help: Pop up each new message on any OmniView showing this face

settings.label: Show scan-to-subscribe code
settings.help: A QR code a phone can scan to follow this topic too

settings.label: Code opens
settings.help: The app subscribes in one tap. The web page works on any phone, app or not
